note: City of Pleasant Hill campground at City Lake, south-east of town: electric RV sites and primitive sites, with a restroom and shower building. Disc golf, mountain-bike trail, shelters, playground, kayak launch and boat ramp; a city boat permit is needed for the lake. --Claude
summary: Only the city's City Lake facility page could be read: it confirms 'Electric R/V & primitive camp sites', lists 'Restroom and shower facilities' (the stored 'portable toilets only, no showers' is contradicted - showers now true), and gives phone 816-540-3135 and 16104 S. Lake. The Fee Schedule and Rules pages are behind a bot check and UNREAD, so the 2026 rates, what separates $20 from $25, amperage, site count, season, stay limit and reservation method are all still unanswered. Possible waterfront upgrade lead on imagery, not confirmable.
flags: UNREAD (the main questions): the Fee Schedule page (the stored fees source, read 2026-10-10 by an earlier pass) and the Rules & Regulations page both returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare 'Performing security verification' screen, to plain HTTP, to the headless browser, and to a second fetch tool; the Wayback Machine holds only a 2023 copy of the fee page and refused the request. So I could not answer: the 2026 rates; what separates the $20 and $25 electric rates and the $10 and $15 primitive rates (resident/non-resident is the usual split for a city lake, but that is a guess and is not written); amperage; water at the sites; dump station; number of sites; season; reservation method and cancellation; stay limit; rig length. Fees and booking are left exactly as stored. The 'Shelter Locations' PDF (the nearest thing to a site map) was also refused.

FACILITIES CHANGE: stored showers false (derived from the note's 'portable toilets only, no showers'). The city's facility page lists 'Restroom and shower facilities' among City Lake's amenities, and imagery shows a small building beside the playground on the peninsula loop. Written showers true and the note line dropped. Whether the toilets are flush is not stated.

WATERFRONT LEAD UP (not confirmable - stored not waterfront, 'defaulted down'): on leaf-off imagery the north shore drive (around 38.8264,-94.2952) has four or five short gravel spurs on the LAKE side of the drive, 10-20 m from the water with mown grass and scattered trees and nothing between them and the shore. If those spurs are the electric RV sites this is lakefront by the open-apron test. No page I could read says which spurs are campsites (no site map; the fee and rules pages are unread), and the peninsula loop by the pin looks like day use (playground, restroom, shelter at the tip). Left as stored; a phone call to the city or a read of the rules page by a person would settle it.

PIN: stored 38.82450,-94.29400 is on the park drive at the neck of the peninsula, about 110 m east of the playground loop and about 230 m south-east of the north shore spurs. Inside the park and on a road; if the north shore spurs prove to be the RV sites, 38.82640,-94.29520 would be the better pin. No move proposed until the sites are identified.
PHONE / WEBSITE: stored 816-540-3135 matches the facility page (City of Pleasant Hill main line; address 16104 S. Lake). Website is the right page.
ACCESS: gravel county road (S Lake Rd) to a gravel park drive on imagery; nothing limiting seen. Not read from a page.

OTHER SOURCES: a web search turned up only an undated visitmo.com line with old figures ($15 hookup / $7 primitive, 'monthly rates for extended stays') and a single-site Hipcamp stub; neither is current nor the operator's, so nothing was taken from them. The 'monthly rates' line would be worth asking the city about (long-stay share unknown).
